name: The Langham Boston
insider_take: This grand dame of Boston hospitality sits in the heart of the Financial District, where Federal Reserve history meets modern luxury in a building that once housed the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston.
whats_special: The Langham Boston occupies a stunning Renaissance Revival building from 1922, featuring the city's most spectacular banking hall turned into Grana restaurant. The hotel's signature afternoon tea service continues a 150-year Langham tradition, while the Chuan Body + Soul spa offers the only traditional Chinese wellness treatments in downtown Boston.
pro_tip: Book the Chairman's Suite for exclusive access to the original Federal Reserve vault door, now serving as a dramatic entrance to the suite's private dining area.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps from the Freedom Trail, Faneuil Hall, and the waterfront. The building's original bronze details and marble work create Instagram-worthy moments, especially in the soaring lobby that showcases Boston's financial heritage.
pros: Historic Federal Reserve Bank building with stunning architecture
Prime Financial District location near major attractions
Award-winning Grana restaurant and sophisticated dining options
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Historic building may have limited modern amenities in some areas
